description: Estimate the penalty to break a Canadian mortgage: three months' interest vs the interest rate differential (IRD), incl. the big-bank posted-rate method. Fixed = greater of the two; variable = usually three months' interest. The three optional rate inputs are lender-specific: if omitted, illustrative site defaults are used (the answer can be several times off) and listed in `assumedInputs` — show them to the user and have them confirm with their lender.

contractRatePct.description: Your contract rate as a percent, e.g. 5.25

currentRateForRemainingTermPct.description: Monoline method: today's rate for the remaining term (percent). Omit if unknown (assumption is flagged).

lenderMethod.description: Big banks use the posted-rate IRD, monolines actual rates. Either can be larger, depending on the original discount vs today's posted rate.

postedAtOriginationPct.description: Big-bank method: posted (not discounted) rate when signed, from the mortgage documents. Can change the penalty several-fold. Omit if unknown (assumption is flagged).

todaysPostedForClosestTermPct.description: Big-bank method: the lender's posted rate today for the closest term. Omit if unknown (assumption is flagged).

name: mortgage_penalty
title: Mortgage Prepayment Penalty Calculator (IRD)
